simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שַׁלְהֶבֶת (H7957) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שַׁלְהֶבֶת (shalhebeth) means a flare of fire First listed occurrence: Ezek 21 3.

definitions.full: H7957. shalhebeth שַׁלְהֶ֫בֶת noun feminine flame (Aramaic שַׁלְהוֺבִיתָא ) — in שׁ ׳לַהֶבֶת Ezek 21:3 , of judgment; so שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת Job 15:30 ; שַׁלְהֶבֶתְיָה אֵשׁ רִשְׁמֵּי Song 8:6 i.e. Yahweh-flame = powerful flame (> Jäger BAS i.471 Jastr JBL xiii (1894), 111 explains יָֿה here as encl. particle)
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 3851 with sibilant prefix;
